faqs.q: Which captain has won the most IPL titles?
faqs.a: Rohit Sharma and MS Dhoni share the record, with five IPL titles each as captain up to the 2026 season. Rohit won his with Mumbai Indians in 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019 and 2020, and Dhoni won his with Chennai Super Kings in 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021 and 2023.

faqs.q: Which team has won the most IPL titles?
faqs.a: Mumbai Indians and Chennai Super Kings are joint leaders with five titles each up to the 2026 season. Kolkata Knight Riders have three, and Royal Challengers Bengaluru won back-to-back titles in 2025 and 2026 under Rajat Patidar.

faqs.q: Is Rohit Sharma still the captain of Mumbai Indians?
faqs.a: No. Mumbai Indians handed the captaincy to Hardik Pandya from the 2024 season, ending Rohit Sharma's long run as captain that began in 2013. All five of Rohit's IPL titles as captain came with Mumbai Indians between 2013 and 2020.

faqs.q: Why was CSK banned from the IPL for two years?
faqs.a: Chennai Super Kings and Rajasthan Royals were suspended for the 2016 and 2017 seasons after a Supreme Court-appointed committee found officials of both franchises guilty of betting during IPL 2013. The players were not punished, and MS Dhoni played for Rising Pune Supergiant during those two seasons before returning to CSK in 2018.
